svg.text: Anatomy of a BFF — five responsibility layers.
One client request, seven internal calls
The client sees one request and one response. Behind the BFF: parallel fan-out,
shape translation, auth swap, protocol switch.
JSON over HTTP/2 • client-tailored timeouts & retries
Fan out 7 downstream calls in parallel; await all
Drop unused fields, flatten nesting, rename per client convention
Compose JSON • compress • add cache headers
